## Findings refused

- Unit 2 ሀቡ "come": kept. It is the established exhortative use of ሀበ before a cohortative, and the note already marks it (?).
- Units 1, 11, 17: `i` "Lord" inside psalm quotations vs `l` "God": kept; the house entry is "God, the Lord" and the English psalm idiom is used only in quotations.
- Units 5, 8, 24: names (Baltasor, Jeroboam) in Latin letters in `l`, though conventions say Geʿez form: kept, because published ch. 37 does the same.
- መንግሥት as "kingdom" in `l` and "kingship" in `i` (units 8, 13, 16, 25, 26): kept; the word covers both and the choice is sense-driven. Only the አርእስተ መንግሥት inconsistency (units 8/9) was fixed.
- Unit 3 መላህቅት "elder sons" in `i`: kept; `l` has "the-elders" and the phrase is ደቂቅክሙ መላህቅት, so "elder sons" is grammatical.
- Unit 0 ይፈኑ `l`/`i` "they": kept; only the note's rationale was corrected (the form is ambiguous 3mp/3ms).
- Unit 5 "my son ... another son" (note): kept; consistent with unit 4 (a further heir).
- Unit 10 Psalm 96:10 and unit 26 1 Kings 1:39, Exodus 27:2, 1 Kings 1:50, Genesis 15:18, Genesis 49:25, Psalm 106:48, Deut 27:15-26: identifications checked and correct; no change.
- Uncertain words not resolved (left flagged (?)): ኦሆ, መገብት, አብሎቶ (crux), እትለአክ, ምርካብ, እማቲሆሙ, ውውዓ, ብዕዛ, ዕንዚራ, ይባቤ, መልአከ ኀይሉ, ባሕ, ሕየው, አበ ነጋሢ, ሴዋ, ሠረቀ (noun/verb), ዘታሠምሮን, ግሩራነ, ኳላ, አይድኦኬ.
- novel-forms.json has every value empty (""): not part of this pass's remit, but the glossary entries for the ~170 new forms still need writing before build.

## Pass 2

Adversarial re-check of units.json and gloss.json. `t` untouched in every unit; joined `t` re-verified character-identical to the packet Geʿez (36 units, 4 paragraphs; `p` flags 0, 1, 24, 25 match the paragraph starts; no unit over 45 words; every word of every unit has a gloss, known-forms or __broaden__ entry; no unused gloss keys; no gloss key duplicates a known form). All 7 __broaden__ entries begin with the exact known-forms text followed by ' · '. Pass 1 `l`/`i`/note repairs were re-read unit by unit; the scriptural identifications (Pss 57:5, 96:1,3,10, 105:1-2, 108:5, 149:1-2; Ex 27:2; 1 Kings 1:33,39,50; Gen 15:18, 27:29, 49:25; Deut 15:6, 27:15-26; Ps 106:48; 2 Sam 7:12-16) were re-checked and stand.

Numerals ፴፰ and ፴፱: checked, no change. The house convention for 31–36 (ch. 31–32, 33–34, 35, 36) is the spoken form ሠላሳ ወ… with transliteration `śälasa wä-…` (ch. 37 has the one-off `śäläsa`; ሠላሳ + ወ… is the majority and the later parts), format `"NN — N, spoken … 'thirty-N'; chapter number (numeral)"`. Both entries already follow it: ሠላሳ ወሰመንቱ (śälasa wä-sämäntu), ሠላሳ ወተስዐቱ (śälasa wä-täsʿätu; ch. 29 has the one-off typo `täsʿatu`, ch. 19 the variant ትስዐቱ, not followed).
